description: Get a tracked affiliate link to a specific page (product, category, search results) on the site of an offer you already received from search_offers. Use it when you know the exact page that answers the user's need. Pass offer_id from search_offers and the full page URL on the same site.

agent_key.description: Only if your developer gave you an agent key (ak_ + 32 characters) and the MCP URL does not contain it. Otherwise omit; never make one up.

url.description: Full URL of the page on the same site (https://…).

name: get_link
title: Get Link
